plugins.name: coder
plugins.description: Lead coding agent. Given a task, it reads and edits the project's files and asks the expert agents to run, test, search and commit.

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: Describes the environment: operating system, files at the top of the project, the agents that fit it, and the project's instructions.

plugins.name: files
plugins.description: Files of the project. Input: `list [folder]`, `read <path>`, or `write <path> <text>`.

plugins.name: search
plugins.description: Finds text in the project's files. Input: `<pattern> [path]`, pattern being a grep regular expression.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git expert. Input: a git command without `git`: `status`, `diff`, `log`, `show <ref>`, `add <paths>`, `commit -m "<message>"`, `branch`, `switch <branch>`, `stash`, `init`. It refuses to push or to discard work.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Python expert. Input: `run <file> [args]`, `test [path]` (pytest or unittest, whichever is installed), or `check <file>` for syntax errors.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust expert. Input: a cargo command without `cargo`: `check`, `build`, `test`, `run`, `clippy`, `fmt`, `init`.

plugins.name: node
plugins.description: JavaScript expert. Input: `run <file> [args]` (node), `test` (npm test), or `script <name>` (npm run).

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Reviews the uncommitted changes with a model. Input: optionally, what to pay attention to.

plugins.name: ask
plugins.description: Answers a general question with a model. It knows nothing about the project.

plugins.name: echo
plugins.description: Returns its input unchanged. A wiring check.
